lines: When everything changes, what stays the same?
当一切都在变化，什么保持不变？
Philosophers have asked this for two and a half thousand years. This project answers it with theorems, and marks exactly where the theorems stop.
哲学家问了两千五百年。这个项目用定理来回答，并精确标出定理在哪里止步。
A good coordinate system is a frame that stays fixed under transformation.
好的坐标系，是变换之下保持不动的标架。
That single idea, the fixed point, runs from geometry to truth, to justice, to beauty.
这一个想法——不动点——从几何贯穿到真理、正义与美。
Start with the smallest unit of thought. A concept is not a word. It is a map that sorts states into classes.
从思想的最小单位开始。概念不是一个词，而是一张把状态分进各类的映射。
Every concept splits the world into fibers, and objects are what a fiber collects. Proved in Lean: the world is exactly the sum of its fibers.
每个概念都把世界切分成纤维，对象就是一条纤维所收集的东西。在 Lean 中证明：世界恰好等于它的纤维之和。
And defining a concept does not make its object exist. Being definable, being constructed, having a model, being realized: four separate notions, each separated by a proof.
而定义一个概念，并不使它的对象存在。可定义、可构造、有模型、被实现——四个不同的概念，每一对都由证明分开。
How do concepts move? Two states look the same today, but their futures differ. That pair is a counterexample to your concept.
概念如何运动？两个状态今天看起来一样，未来却不同。这一对，就是你概念的反例。
Negation is not P and not P. It is a concept's claim of closure, broken by a witness.
否定不是“P 且非 P”。否定是一个概念自称封闭的主张，被一个见证击穿。
The repair is to join the old concept with what the future needs. Lean proves it is the least repair that keeps every old distinction. Affirmation, negation, sublation, as a theorem.
修复的办法，是把旧概念与未来所需的东西合并。Lean 证明：这是保留全部旧区分的最小修复。肯定、否定、扬弃——成为一条定理。
What makes you, you? If memories can be inherited by two successors at once, then memory inheritance cannot be identity. Branching breaks it.
是什么让你成为你？如果记忆可以同时被两个后继者继承，那么记忆继承就不可能是同一性。分叉打破了它。

And meaning? Keep the same text and the same rule of interpretation. Change the reader, the background, the goal, and a different stable meaning can emerge. Interpretation has more than one fixed point.
那么意义呢？文本不变，诠释规则不变。换一个读者、换一个背景、换一个目的，就能浮现出另一个稳定的意义。诠释有不止一个不动点。

Why do people still disagree when they know the same facts? Proved: complete information can still leave norms divided. Shared facts align decisions under a shared rule; different rules can still disagree after everything is disclosed.
为什么人们知道同样的事实，却仍然分歧？已证明：完备的信息依然可能让规范分裂。共享的事实能在同一规则下让决策一致；不同的规则，即使一切都已公开，仍可能分歧。
And the echo chamber, in one line: repeating messages from a single source can never resolve what that source cannot see.
回音室，一行就能说清：重复同一个来源的消息，永远无法解决那个来源看不见的东西。
No audit from inside a classification can find the differences that classification deleted.
从一个分类内部进行的任何审计，都找不到这个分类自己删掉的差异。
Justice. When an event is perfectly symmetric among n people, there is no fair single culprit. Each share of responsibility is exactly one over n.
正义。当一个事件在 n 个人之间完全对称，就不存在公平的唯一罪魁。每一份责任恰好是 n 分之一。
A procedure can be complete and fair, and still produce a wrong outcome. A rule can be fully explainable, and still not contestable.
一个程序可以完整而公正，却仍然产出错误的结果。一条规则可以完全可解释，却仍然无法申诉。
And the test of a universal value: it survives swapping who plays which role. A privilege reserved for one named party does not.
普遍价值的检验：它经得起角色互换。为某个具名者保留的特权，经不起。
Freedom. A future that is a total function of the present is exactly a future that never branches.
自由。一个完全由现在决定的未来，恰好是一个从不分叉的未来。
Whether a choice is yours depends on the interface. If the observer's view recovers the decision, the control is internal. If the view hides it, the control looks external.
一个选择是否属于你，取决于界面。如果观察者的视角能恢复这个决定，控制就是内在的；如果视角遮蔽了它，控制就显得是外来的。
In the project's philosophy, freedom has a precise address: the frontier. It is the part that logic has not decided for us.
在这个项目的哲学里，自由有一个精确的地址：前沿。它是逻辑尚未替我们决定的那一部分。
Truth, goodness, beauty. Truth is what has been frozen. Goodness is the class of transformations that preserve it. Beauty is the order by which we choose at the frontier.
真、善、美。真，是已被冻结的东西。善，是保持它的那一类变换。美，是我们在前沿上做选择的先验次序。
Beauty proposes. Goodness checks honestly. Truth freezes. And beauty is not a function of truth: no state of the ledger can choose the next question for you.
美提出，善诚实地检验，真冻结。而美不是真的函数：账本的任何状态，都无法替你选择下一个问题。
Two ethical laws are adopted, not derived: the account must balance, and admission must not depend on who is asking. Ought is never smuggled out of is.
两条伦理律是被采纳的，而不是被推导的：账必须平；准入不取决于提问的是谁。“应当”从未被偷偷从“是”里推出。
So what can no transformation move? Exactly two things: what is already frozen, and what can never be frozen.
那么，什么是任何变换都动不了的？恰好两种：已经冻结的，和永远冻不了的。
Everything else is the frontier. Mathematics is not the greatest fixed point. It is an endless ladder, climbing a gap it cannot close. The width of that gap is called incompleteness.
其余一切，都是前沿。数学不是最大的不动点。它是一架无尽的阶梯，攀爬在一道无法闭合的沟里。那道沟的宽度，叫作不完备性。

Old ideas take on new edges. Leibniz: things that no readout can tell apart. Kant: identical evidence can leave a hidden coordinate undetermined. Wittgenstein: the same sentence acts differently in different contexts. Spinoza: sharing a source does not make contents the same.
古老的思想有了新的棱角。莱布尼茨：没有任何读数能区分的东西。康德：完全相同的证据，可以留下一个未被决定的隐藏坐标。维特根斯坦：同一句话，在不同语境里起不同的作用。斯宾诺莎：共享一个来源，并不使内容相同。
These are structural readings, not claims about what the philosophers meant. And a statement is not false merely because it is incomplete.
这些是结构性的解读，而不是对哲学家原意的断言。而一种表述，并不因为不完整就是错的。
What can be proved will one day emigrate into mathematics. Philosophy keeps watch over what cannot.
能证明的，终将移民成数学。哲学，是为不可移民者守夜的职务。
Beauty is the compass. Logic is the ratchet. And the account must balance.
美是罗盘，逻辑是棘轮。而账，必须平。
